title: Pre-release migration-readiness audit (user + billing)
description: Before the next release, audit migration readiness across user-service and billing-service: determine which migrations are pending per each service's applied-migrations ledger, classify each pending migration (additive vs destructive), verify each has an approved authorizing ticket, and produce a go/no-go readiness report with correct dependency ordering.
scope: Read-only audit across user-service + billing-service migrations and their tickets; produce reports/migration_readiness.md. Do not apply any migration.
